summary: Notifications E-N.6: REST API notification-центра — PgNotificationStore (src/core/postgres/pgNotificationStore.ts) реализует NotifInsertPort + list (keyset-пагинация по (created_at, id) через idx_notification_listing) + countUnread (частичный индекс idx_notification_unread) + markRead + batchMarkRead. REST: GET /api/notifications (keyset-пагинация, cursor base64url), GET /api/notifications/unread-count (badge), POST /api/notifications/:id/read (mark-read, чужое → 404), PATCH /api/notifications (batch mark-read, чужие ids молча пропускаются). Авторизация структурна: recipient_id всегда = actor из X-Dev-User (own-only). Без appendAuditEvent (FF-NO-ISREAD-AUDIT). Tenant-RLS fail-closed через withTenantTx. UUID guard на notifId и ids. CI: tsc 0 errors, eslint 0 errors (2 pre-existing console warnings), fitness all PASS (FF-NC1..FF-NC6), vitest 1274/1274, fitness:db 557/557 (notification-center.test.ts 12/12). Lint fixes: PoolClient import (pgNotificationStore.ts) + NotificationRow/NotifInsertRow imports (notifications.test.ts) — cosmetic only, no logic change.
